description: This file declares functions, constants, and data accessors related to associated devices management within the harvester system, including setting and getting harvesting status, reporting, and polling periods, as well as configuration validation and external dependencies.

methods.name: SetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for associated devices to enabled or disabled.

methods.name: GetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting interval in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default reporting period for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period in seconds for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Gets the default polling period for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Retrieves the timeout after which the intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout for accelerated polling after which IDW intervals return to default.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for IDW scan acceleration.

methods.name: ValidateIDWPeriod
methods.description: Validates that the given interval is within the valid range.

methods.name: isvalueinarray
methods.description: Checks if a given value exists within an array of ULONG values.
